args.question: For Xiao Bai, what do you mean by a “cleaning system”?
args.context: For a Samoyed, this could mean a grooming vacuum for loose fur, a robotic floor-cleaning system, or bathing/drying equipment; these have very different prices and maintenance costs.
options: Grooming vacuum/clipper system for brushing and collecting shed fur
Robot vacuum/mop for floors and pet hair
Compare all three and recommend the most cost-effective option
